div.div:
Coverage & Nodes (connectivity.md, ASM-070)
• 200 farms in Cauca, Huila, Tolima; 2 nodes per farm
• Moisture (10/30cm), temp, RH, and NPK readings
Transport & Buffer
• Cellular LPWA (LTE-M/NB-IoT), MQTT over TLS 1.2+ (port 8883)
• Mutual X.509 cert authentication; 24h offline buffer
Alert Budget
• < 5 min delivery budget for live readings (ASM-075)

div.div:
Ingress & Broker
• AWS IoT Core in us-east-1 with mutual X.509 mTLS
• Scoped topic: aroma/{farm_id}/telemetry
Topic Rule Actions (ADR-003, ASM-161)
• SQL: SELECT * FROM 'aroma/+/telemetry'
• Action 1: Direct PutItem to DynamoDB telemetry table
• Action 2: SQS message action to infthresholdqueue
Error Handling
• Rule error action routes to SQS DLQ after 5 attempts

div.div:
Telemetry Table (ADR-003, farm-monitoring.md)
• telemetry table (PK: node_id, SK: timestamp)
• KMS CMK encrypted (telemetry key class); 5-year TTL
• Strongly consistent reads for evaluation (ASM-161)
Thresholds Table (sec 4)
• thresholds table with versioned Federation ranges
• Farm-specific scope evaluated first, then pilot scope

div.div:
SQS Trigger & Config (ASM-161, ASM-162)
• Queue infthresholdqueue, batch size 10 (ASM-162)
• 60s timeout, 256MB memory, reserved concurrency 10
Evaluation Logic (farm-monitoring.md sec 5)
• Strongly consistent read from DynamoDB telemetry
• Evaluates reading against active Federation thresholds
• Thresholds are Federation data, never hardcoded in SQL
Alerting & Canary (ASM-174)
• Out of range: writes crop_alert_raised and emits to SNS
• Deployed via CodeDeploy canary: 10% 5 min (ASM-174)

• Links alert to plot pest case; switches to precision mode
• Pilot-wide observation metrics emitted to CloudWatch

div.div:
Flight Missions (ADR-002, drone-service.md)
• Combined flight mode; certified commercial UAV pilot
• Photos, track, maps, polygons, and flight record
On-Device Person Screen (ASM-164)
• On-device screen sets person_screen manifest flag
• Zero cloud detectors used; cryptographic privacy
Authentication & Buffer (sec 7)
• Cognito staff pool with MFA for pilot staff
• 24h buffer retained until signed receipt received

div.div:
Object Storage Target (drone-service.md sec 7)
• Workload S3 bucket with mission-prefixed keys
• Direct upload via pre-signed URL from upload grant
• S3 verifies SHA-256 header checksum (HTTP 400 on error)
Encryption & Retention (ASM-097)
• KMS CMK encryption under drone key class
• 5-year retention enforced by S3 lifecycle rules
Person Screening & Quarantine (ASM-165)
• Files with person present moved to restricted/person/
• Encrypted under 8th KMS key class restricted (deny functions)

div.div:
Manifest Validation & Receipt (sec 7)
• Reception Lambda validates manifest and SHA-256 checksums
• Writes mission item to DynamoDB missions (record_persisted)
• Returns receipt to ground station to release local buffer
Event Routing to Inference (ASM-161)
• DynamoDB Stream captures record_persisted events
• EventBridge Pipe routes filtered events to custom drone bus
• EventBridge rules dispatch to dedicated SQS queue per mission
• Inference Lambda event source mapping reads with batch size 1

div.div:
Managed Foundation Model (ASM-160)
• Amazon Bedrock on-demand in us-east-1 (Amazon Nova Pro)
• Zero-shot prompts & versioned JSON output schemas
• Zero training, fine-tuning, or persistent compute
Confidence & Boundaries (ASM-160, ASM-163)
• Generates confidence score; threshold ≥ 0.70 to confirm
• Persists timestamp, confidence, and source object key
• NEVER authorizes fumigation or flight dispatch directly

div.div:
Human Authorization (ADR-002)
• Federation certified agronomist reviews AI confidence & photos
• Authorizes fumigation prescription as human with MFA
Order & Case Progression
• Updates case to focus_confirmed; verification flight closes case
Traceability & Origin Audit
• Immutable DynamoDB audit trail (5-year retention)
